paper.title_en: Quasinormal Modes Criticality across Black Hole Extremality
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the extremal solution branch to nonextremal branch transition in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg anti-de Sitter black holes, where the nonlinear electromagnetic parameter $λ$ governs the existence of the extremal branch solution. At fixed pressure and charge, extremal black hole only exist for $λ\leqλ_c$. For $λ>λ_c$, the lowest Hawking temperature keeps nonzero. Near this threshold, the lowest temperature follows a linear critical scaling, $T_{\min}\propto(λ-λ_c)^{α_T}$. We investigate the corresponding dynamical behavior by computing the quasinormal modes of a massless scalar perturbation along the lowest-temperature black hole branch. As the critical threshold is approached, two complex-frequency quasinormal modes branches collide on the imaginary axis and reorganize into distinct purely imaginary branches. Then the imaginary parts of these modes, together with higher overtones, reach zero at the critical threshold, described by $Γ_n\propto(λ-λ_c)^{α_n}$, with $α_n\simeqα_T$. The resulting zero-damped modes become increasingly localized near the event horizon, and their relative damping rates closely follow the overtone spacing predicted by the near-horizon AdS$_2$ spectrum. Our results show that the thermodynamic and dynamical critical behavior remain closely connected even when extremal black hole solutions cease to exist, providing further evidence for the relevance of near-extremal spectral behavior in this distinct critical regime.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg反de Sitter黑洞在极端分支消失后的临界行为，将热力学临界标度与准正规模动力学联系起来，理论深度较高，问题聚焦且方法清晰（标度分析与微扰频谱计算），值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 跨黑洞极端性的准正规模临界性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg反de Sitter黑洞中从极端解分支到非极端解分支的转变，其中非线性电磁参数$\lambda$决定了极端分支解的存在性。在固定压力和电荷下，极端黑洞仅当$\lambda\leq\lambda_c$时存在。对于$\lambda>\lambda_c$，最低Hawking温度保持非零。在该阈值附近，最低温度遵循线性临界标度，$T_{\min}\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_T}$。我们通过计算沿最低温度黑洞分支的无质量标量微扰的准正规模，研究了相应的动力学行为。当趋近临界阈值时，两个复频率准正规模分支在虚轴上碰撞，并重组为不同的纯虚分支。随后，这些模式的虚部连同更高阶泛音在临界阈值处达到零，由$\Gamma_n\propto(\lambda-\lambda_c)^{\alpha_n}$描述，其中$\alpha_n\simeq\alpha_T$。由此产生的零阻尼模式越来越局域化于事件视界附近，其相对阻尼率密切遵循近视界AdS$_2$谱所预言的泛音间距。我们的结果表明，即使在极端黑洞解不再存在的情况下，热力学和动力学的临界行为仍然密切相关，这为近极端谱行为在这一独特临界区域中的相关性提供了进一步证据。
